dlg.chid.first.0.intent: greets a fellow of his dead Order
dlg.chid.first.0.wants: company, a lit Order lamp, family
dlg.chid.first.0.hides: what he is, how old, what the lamps burn
dlg.chid.first.0.note: The catch of joy on 'Lit!'. No rue on 'which is fair': he likes the name, and the laugh is delight on the out-breath. 'It used to work.' cheerful and practical, like a man reporting a broken pump; the sadness belongs to the listener. Chid is never cynical and never self-pitying.
dlg.chid.first.0.beats: Oh! [beat] A lantern of the Order! [breath] Lit! Oh, sit down, sit, sit. I'm Chid. They call me the Fool, which is fair. [laugh] This is the shrine of the Morning Light. [beat] It used to work.

dlg.chid.first.1.hides: what he is, how old, what the lamps burn
dlg.chid.first.1.note: Bright 'Oh!'. He likes the name 'the Fool'; the laugh is delight. 'It used to work.' cheerful and practical.
dlg.chid.first.1.beats: Oh! A visitor. [beat] Hello! I'm Chid. They call me the Fool, which is fair. [laugh] This is the shrine of the Morning Light. [beat] It used to work.

dlg.chid.hub.0.note: Can't keep it in. Second 'Still burning.' softer, to himself, amazed.

dlg.chid.hub.1.note: Light joke at his own expense on 'I'm trying to be.'

dlg.chid.woke.0.wants: you to rest and believe the flame saved you
dlg.chid.woke.0.note: 'Good. Good!' overflowing. Awe and a catch on 'the flame... the flame kept you'. Quieter and serious for the warning; 'They always keep something' with old knowledge he doesn't notice.

dlg.chid.woke.1.note: Gentle; trails off on 'and... well.' with an embarrassed little laugh. Serious and quiet for the warning.

dlg.chid.where.0.note: Storytelling; 'Be careful.' sincere. 'It knows your smell now.' quiet.

dlg.chid.before.0.note: 'Have I? Oh. Well.' flustered. Then quiet and plain: properly cold. A long pause; 'It's been a long time' much older than he sounds. 'Rest, now.' tender.

dlg.chid.shrine.0.note: Sincere about the blessing; falters on 'trying'. Comic list building; 'That was a bad day.' rueful.

dlg.chid.lit.0.note: Near tears with joy. 'WORKS' stressed. Voice cracks on 'Oh, thank you!'

dlg.chid.blessed.0.note: Gentle and fond, like tucking someone in.

dlg.chid.warden.0.note: 'which is a long time' slips out with a little laugh he shouldn't have. The last sentence quietly profound.

dlg.chid.vault.0.intent: what he knows of the door
dlg.chid.vault.0.note: Short halting sentences. 'That, I think, is the answer.' quiet and pointed.

dlg.chid.below.0.note: The Order's saying recited, then a shiver: 'It sounds like a threat.'

dlg.chid.long.0.note: Cuts himself off at 'Since—'. Fond laugh on 'Terrible bread'. Hurried change of subject on 'Is that the time?'

dlg.chid.cb_opened_vault.0.note: Breathless; cuts himself off. Flip-flops: 'No, don't tell me. Yes, tell me. No.' comic and frightened.

dlg.chid.cb_vault2.0.intent: the dead still guard the stair
dlg.chid.cb_vault2.0.note: 'Good. Good, I think.' unsure. Then a nervous resolve on the candles.

dlg.chid.cb_core_stolen.0.note: Quiet, the joy gone. 'Oh, dear. Oh, dear, dear.' genuinely frightened. The last line almost to himself.

dlg.chid.cb_nemesis_slain.0.note: Answers his own question. Fussing: 'Not there. There.'

dlg.chid.say_calling.0.note: Wonder at the shield. Pause on '... dents.' then cheerful reassurance.

dlg.chid.say_calling.1.note: Not a lecture. 'fire with manners' with a small smile.

dlg.chid.say_calling.2.note: Fascination; catches himself. 'I won't, but I'll try.' sheepish honesty.

dlg.chid.say_calling.3.note: Startled first line; deadpan little joke about the spiders.

dlg.chid.say_calling.4.note: Startled first line; deadpan little joke about the spiders.

dlg.chid.names.0.note: Tentative question. Long pause. Kind, grave and very old for 'It always takes the names first. Then the faces.' Then the apology, and a too-quick brightening: 'Sit, sit.'

dlg.chid.t_chid.0.note: 'Loud!' laughing. Warm memory of Brother Aumery. Then quiet: they're all gone. 'I keep not.' barely held.

dlg.chid.note.0.intent: hides that he wrote the note
dlg.chid.note.0.note: Too-bright 'Was there!'. Babbling names; stops dead at 'Cormac, once, who—'. Then fond, quieter, almost giving himself away on 'in... well. Ages.'

bark.chid.day.2.emo: cheerful, and older than he sounds

bark.chid.night.3.note: The Order's saying, then a little laugh at the long night.

dlg.chid.cb_nell.0.intent: after the burial he sang at
dlg.chid.cb_nell.0.wants: to look after the one who put her down
dlg.chid.cb_nell.0.hides: he knows what the irons are for; 'somebody' is Vonnra's alto
dlg.chid.cb_nell.0.note: Light and offhand on the singing; 'I always have' is older than he looks, and he doesn't notice saying it. Narrator plain; three seconds of silence. 'She was very light' barely voiced, one catch on 'light', no sob. 'By me.' quiet, almost asking.
dlg.chid.cb_nell.0.beats: I sang it flat. [beat] I always have. [breath] There's always somebody who has the tune. | [silence 3 s] She was very light. [breath] ...Sit down a minute. [beat] Not on the step. [beat] Here. [beat] By me.

dlg.chid.cb_nell.1.wants: to look after the one who put her down
dlg.chid.cb_nell.1.hides: he knows what the irons are for, and he was at the ford the night she got up
dlg.chid.cb_nell.1.note: 'Of course, iron' fond: the half-second before it holds the sting (iron is what drowned her), so don't play the irony. Narrator plain, no sorrow; then three seconds of silence. 'She was very light' barely voiced, one catch allowed on 'light', no sob. His ordinary self comes back on 'Not on the step'; under the care he is the one who needs the company, and 'By me.' is quiet, almost asking.
dlg.chid.cb_nell.1.beats: We buried Nell behind the shrine, next to old Ashe. [beat] Brannoc made the marker himself. Iron. [beat] Of course, iron. | [silence 3 s] She was very light. [breath] ...Sit down a minute. [beat] Not on the step. [beat] Here. [beat] By me.
